title: FAQ
subtitle: Things clients ask me a lot

questions.label: What services do you offer?
questions.content: Full-cycle web application development (React, Vue, Next.js, Laravel, FastAPI), RESTful API and backend development, legacy system migration (C#/VB.NET Webforms), and database design.

questions.label: How do we start working together?
questions.content: Message me directly on Fastwork — describe your project and I'll get back with a scope, timeline and quote.

questions.label: How much does a project cost?
questions.content: It depends on scope, features and timeline. Check my service listings on Fastwork for starting prices, or send me your requirements for an exact quote.

questions.label: How long does a project take?
questions.content: Small fixes and APIs usually take a few days; full web applications typically run 2-6 weeks depending on complexity.

questions.label: What do you enjoy most about this work?
questions.content: Building things from zero — turning an idea into a working product people actually use, and making legacy systems fast and modern again.
